key_insight: Molecular Prior Networks predict drug–target affinity from labelled support molecules in a single transformer forward pass, without task-specific training.
engineering_relevance: The approach can accelerate low-data affinity modelling for drug discovery by reusing patterns learned across existing affinity datasets.
method: Train a transformer on thousands of existing molecular affinity datasets.
Condition query predictions on labelled support molecules.
Compare against kernel regression in a meta-learned feature space to probe the role of molecular similarity.
evidence_signal: On the regression variant of FS-Mol, the model matches state-of-the-art performance for the smallest support sets while running faster than existing methods.
watch_item: The reported state-of-the-art match is limited to the smallest support sets; broader performance across dataset sizes and novel targets requires verification.
